about: Hardcore route rules for tools/guide_draft.py --hardcore (docs/HARDCORE.md). Quest IDs are from the data pack; every rule names where it comes from and how sure that source is. A skip becomes '#skipquest <id> >> <reason>'; a note becomes a '.note' after the quest's '.accept'. Corrected from play (the contributors' deaths) over time. skip_zones: every quest of such a zone is left out of every route (a battleground is not leveling content): the Route Planner reads it; the drafter drafts zones by name and never meets them. A rule may carry class_quest_of (a class token such as WARLOCK, or a list): the quest belongs to that class although the data has no class mask for it (Forever's new quests have none), so the rule skips it for the guides of every other class and leaves it alone for that class's own (guide_draft.rule_applies). A skip whose reason starts with HARDCORE holds only for HARDCORE guides; any other skip holds for every guide, so write one only for a quest nobody should do (a battleground quest) or give it class_quest_of.
